versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Wan 2.7 — Pro Pack for text-to-video generation via RunComfy.
- Documents all model capabilities: multi-reference motion control, audio-driven lip-sync (`audio_url`), prompt expansion, and negative prompting.
- Details when to use Wan 2.7 versus sibling models (HappyHorse 1.0, Seedance 2.0 Pro, Kling Video O1, LTX 2).
- Provides full parameter schema, usage examples, and prompt guidance.
- Outlines key limitations (clip duration, resolution, aspect ratios, audio specs).
- Includes security/privacy guidance and troubleshooting exit codes.
